```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameterized'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Root &ent;">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" sub:id="1">
  <!-- Top-level comment explaining the catalog -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> & entities like &base; unexpanded.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <sub:item>&base;</sub:item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-ent SYSTEM "http://example.com/external.dtd">
  <!ENTITY local-ent "Local Entity Text">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://default.ns" xmlns:ext="http://external.ns">
  <!-- Multi-line 
       comment with various symbols: <>&'" -->
  <ext:child>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with internal markup <hello>world</hello>
    ]]>
  </ext:child>
  <child>&local-ent;</child>
  <?custom-pi action="run" param="test'value"?>
  <ext:child>
    <![CDATA[Second CDATA block]]>
  </ext:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE testDoc [
  <!ELEMENT testDoc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "&entA; and Value B">
  <!ENTITY % paramEntity "<!ELEMENT nested EMPTY>">
  %paramEntity;
  <?xml-meta category="fuzzing"?>
]>
<testDoc xmlns="http://test.org/doc" xmlns:ns1="http://test.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://test.org/ns2">
  <!-- Section 1 Comment: testing entity expansion & CDATA -->
  <ns1:section>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment inside CDATA -->
      Some text data <>&"'
    ]]>
  </ns1:section>
  <ns2:section>&entB;</ns2:section>
  <?ns1-target data="processing instruction payload"?>
</testDoc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY admin "Administrator">
  <!ENTITY security "&admin; Role">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?db-control mode="active"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://xml.database.org" xmlns:sec="http://xml.database.org/security">
  <!--
    Database documentation comment block
    Author: &admin;
  -->
  <sec:record>
    <![CDATA[
      Secured record data with special characters <>&'"
    ]]>
  </sec:record>
  <record>Access level: &security;</record>
  <?sec-pi verify="true"?>
</database>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % custom-pe "CDATA">
  <!ENTITY doc-title "Comprehensive Document">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://ns.example.com/doc" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Header section comment -->
  <header>
    <![CDATA[
      Header CDATA: <html:b>Bold Title</html:b>
    ]]>
  </header>
  <body>
    &doc-title; - Body content with comments and PIs.
    <?html-pi render="full"?>
  </body>
</document>
